theater: 北京幽州城及易州山道

battle.name: 幽州之戰
battle.theater: 北京幽州城及易州山道
battle.brief: 後梁貞明三年、晉天祐十四年、契丹神冊二年三月至八月，契丹主耶律阿保機率大軍南下，圍攻幽州近二百日；晉王李存勖遣周德威、李嗣源、李存審、閻寶等分道馳援，八月於易州山道大破契丹，解幽州之圍。卡面亞述長矛為短柄長刃鐵鏃之祖型，本役中正是契丹騎兵長矛與晉軍拒馬所承襲的那一類長兵。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 這場戰爭是契丹與李存勖的晉（後唐前身）在幽州一線的正面較量，交戰地點是今北京市一帶的幽州城與其西南的易州山道，時間在後梁貞明三年、晉天祐十四年、契丹神冊二年三月至八月。契丹方面，耶律阿保機在九一六年建國稱帝、定都上京臨潢府（今內蒙古巴林左旗南），此時以契丹本部騎兵為主力，兼有草原諸部落的附從騎隊，兵制是軍帳隨行、牧養自隨的遊牧軍隊，並有漢地降軍編入；前線由原晉軍將盧文進出任幽州盧龍軍節度使，率漢軍為先鋒直趨新州，主力則由阿保機親自率領。晉方是李存勖的河東沙陀集團，四月時正與後梁隔黃河相持，兵力被梁軍牽制，主將為周德威、李嗣源、李存審、閻寶等，兵源兼有河東精騎與鎮州、定州等地的州鎮鄉兵。新州原由後唐安金全據守，開戰之初即棄城而逃，後由盧文進的部將劉殷接替。河北諸鎮多持旁觀態度，盧龍軍原刺史劉仁恭一系已失幽州，幽州實際落入契丹之手，所以此役既是兩國邊界的攻防，也是漢地藩鎮與草原帝國爭奪北方關口的第一次大規模較量。
countriesEn: This war was a direct confrontation between the Khitan and Li Cunxu's Jin (the embryo of the Later Tang) along the Youzhou front, fought at Youzhou city in the area of present-day Beijing and along the Yizhou mountain road to its southwest, between March and August of the third year of Zhenming of the Later Liang, the fourteenth year of Tianyou of Jin and the second year of Shence of the Khitan. On the Khitan side, Yelü Abaoji had proclaimed himself emperor in 916 and fixed his capital at Shangjing, Linhuang, south of what is now Balin Left Banner in Inner Mongolia. His host was built on the Khitan tribal cavalry proper, reinforced by the mounted contingents of the other steppe tribes, an army whose camp tents and herds moved with it, and it had absorbed Han Chinese troops who had come over to him. The forward line was entrusted to Lu Wenjin, a former Jin officer who was appointed Youzhou and Lulong Army Commander and led Han troops in a rapid thrust against Xinzhou, while the main body was led by Abaoji in person. The Jin side was Li Cunxu's Hedong Shatuo group, which in the fourth month was locked with the Later Liang across the Yellow River and had its strength tied down by Liang troops. Its commanders were Zhou Dewei, Li Siyuan, Li Cunshen, Yan Bao and others, and its troops combined the fine cavalry of Hedong with locally levied infantry from circuits such as Zhenzhou and Dingzhou. Xinzhou had been held by An Jinquan of the Later Tang, who abandoned the city as soon as the campaign opened, and was then taken over by Liu Yin, a subordinate of Lu Wenjin. Most of the Hebei circuits watched and waited; the line of the former Lulong governor Liu Rengong had already lost Youzhou, and the city was in fact in Khitan hands, so this was a battle over the border between two states as well as the first large-scale attempt by a Han frontier circuit and a steppe empire to contest a northern pass city.
people: 全場的樞紐是契丹主耶律阿保機。他在九一六年於會河流域建國稱帝，建元神冊，把契丹由部落聯盟變成有都城、有官屬、有漢地降臣的國家；九一七年三月下令大舉南侵，自率大軍直指幽州，前線交由盧文進指揮，戰略上以漢地降將打前站、以本部精騎壓陣。盧文進是關鍵的執行者：他原為幽州盧龍軍的將領，熟悉城防與漢地山川，契丹南下時被任為幽州節度使，率軍速攻新州得手，派部將劉殷出任新州刺史；圍幽州期間，他主張挖地道、築土山，逼得城內把銅熔成汁液從城頭傾瀉，契丹士卒日折近千人，是全場最懂得用工程手段消耗守軍的一方。晉王李存勖在戰略兩難中做出關鍵決定：他正與後梁隔黃河相持，分兵則兵力單薄，不救則幽州有失。李嗣源、李存審、閻寶三人力主分兵，李存勖以唐太宗得一李靖即擒頡利自比，稱「今吾有三猛將，何憂哉」，隨即命李嗣源先出。沙陀宿將周德威是第一批攻新州的指揮，兵敗退守；他見李嗣源入城時握手流涕。真正決定山道決戰勝負的則是三人：李嗣源以三千騎為前鋒，脫去甲胄躍馬衝鋒，用契丹語斥責對方，陣中斬其酋長一人；養子李從珂隨父在前鋒騎中；李存審負責設伏與追擊，伐木為鹿角拒馬，又以燃燒的柴草製造煙幕，鼓噪全軍出戰，終使契丹主力在北山崩潰，俘斬萬餘。
peopleEn: The pivot of the whole affair was the Khitan ruler Yelü Abaoji. In 916 he founded his state in the Hui River basin, took the era name Shence, and turned the Khitan from a tribal confederation into a country with a capital, officials and Han defectors in its service; in March of 917 he ordered a full-scale southern campaign, led his own army straight at Youzhou, left the forward command to Lu Wenjin, and in strategy used Han defectors to take the preliminary objectives while his own elite cavalry pressed the assault. Lu Wenjin was the man who carried the plan out: a former officer of the Lulong Army at Youzhou, familiar with the city's defences and with Han country terrain, he was made Youzhou commander on the Khitan side, took Xinzhou in a rapid march, and installed his subordinate Liu Yin as governor there; during the siege of Youzhou he pressed for tunnels and an earthen ramp, and when the defenders melted copper into a liquid and poured it down, Khitan soldiers were dying at the rate of nearly a thousand a day, making him the one on the Khitan side who knew how to use engineering works to grind down a garrison. Li Cunxu of Jin faced a strategic dilemma and made the decisive choice: he was still facing the Later Liang across the Yellow River, so splitting his forces left him too weak, while failing to relieve Youzhou meant losing it outright. Li Siyuan, Li Cunshen and Yan Bao pressed him to divide, and Li Cunxu compared himself with Emperor Taizong of Tang, who had taken Jieli with one Li Jing, declaring that he now had three fierce generals and had nothing to fear; he then sent Li Siyuan out ahead. The Shatuo veteran Zhou Dewei commanded the first attack on Xinzhou, was beaten back and held what was left of the field; when he saw Li Siyuan enter the city he shook hands with him and wept. Beyond Zhou Dewei, three men decided the mountain-road battle: Li Siyuan led three thousand riders as the vanguard, stripped off his armour, charged on horseback, upbraided the Khitan in their own language and cut down one of their chieftains on the field; his adopted son Li Congke rode in the vanguard with him; and Li Cunshen handled the ambush and the pursuit, felling timber for antler-shaped barricades, raising a smoke screen with burning brush, and ordering the drums beaten and the whole army out at once, until the Khitan main body broke on the northern hill and over ten thousand were taken or killed.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛是本場戰爭的標誌性冷兵器：短柄、長刃、鐵鏃，亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。它在此處的作用是作為祖型對照——由亞述的短柄長刃鐵鏃長矛到唐晉之際的長柄長矛，形制已多改變，握法與配重卻一脈相承：草原騎兵把長矛當作貼身纏鬥的最後兵器，兩河流域的方陣步兵把長矛列成密集矛牆，本役兩軍所用的正屬這兩個傳統。契丹騎兵以弓、箭矢為主，輔以短刀、套索與長矛，佩箭壺與長柄刀，作戰中靠騎射拉開距離，再用長矛解決貼身；遊牧式軍隊的營帳、羊群與車帳隨營移動，攻城時更倚賴臨時徵發的雲梯、木構與繩索。晉軍方面，河東沙陀騎兵裝備圓領缺甲、橫刀、長矛與弓箭，鎮州、定州的鄉兵以步卒長矛列陣為主，輔以唐制留下的步槊、陌刀與弓弩，並大量使用拒馬鹿角、欄木與自城上擲下的石塊之類守城器材。攻守雙方都大量消耗木材：盧文進築土山以瞰城，李存審伐木作鹿角，兩處都顯示冷兵器時代攻城與野戰對木料的巨大需求。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card face is the emblematic cold weapon of this story: a short shaft, a long blade and an iron socketed head, which the Assyrians tied together with bows and ironwork as city after city in Mesopotamia fell. Its function here is as an ancestor type for comparison, because from the Assyrian short-shafted, long-bladed, iron-headed spear to the long spears of the Tang and Jin period the form has changed many times over, while the grip and the principle of leverage run in one continuous line: the steppe horsemen used the long spear as the last weapon of close combat, and the phalanx infantry of Mesopotamia set theirs into dense walls of points. The two traditions in this campaign are exactly these two. Khitan cavalry were armed first and foremost with bows and arrows, supported by short sabres, lassos and long spears, with quivers and long-handled sabres carried on the saddle; in action they opened the distance with the bow and settled close fighting with the spear. The nomadic style of army carried tents, sheep and wagon tents along with the column, and for siege work relied on hastily requisitioned ladders, timber frames and ropes. On the Jin side, the Hedong Shatuo cavalry wore round-collared armour and carried sabres, long spears and bows, while the locally levied infantry of Zhenzhou and Dingzhou fought in formation of long spears, supported by the lances, miodao and crossbows inherited from Tang regulations, and they made heavy use of antler barricades, spiked stockades and stones dropped from the walls. Both sides consumed timber on a large scale: Lu Wenjin built an earthen ramp to look down into the city, Li Cunshen felled trees to make antler barricades, and both episodes show the enormous appetite for wood of siege and field combat in the age of cold weapons.
tactics: 契丹的戰法分兩步：三月先遣盧文進率部疾趨新州，以攻堅取城為前哨；主力隨後由阿保機率領，擊敗攻新州不克的周德威，再合圍幽州。守方以盧文進為首，用的是消耗與工程並舉的辦法：在城邊壘土山居高臨下，另挖地道出奇兵突擊，城中把銅熔成液體傾瀉敵陣，日夜不停，使圍城者在近二百天裡折損不斷。晉軍的應對是一場複雜的戰略協調。李存勖當時正與後梁隔黃河對峙，不能盡抽兵力，於是先令李嗣源率軍先出至淶水駐紮，閻寶率鎮州、定州軍隨進，兩軍八月在易州會師，合計約七萬。八月十七日，李嗣源、閻寶、李存審自易州北上，二十三日翻越大房嶺，沿山澗向東行軍，把大軍拉成一條沿谷的長隊。廿三日午後，前鋒李嗣源、李從珂三千騎在距幽州六十里處與契丹騎兵遭遇，契丹退，晉軍分兩翼跟進；契丹據山、晉軍處澗，每到谷口即遭攔截。到山口時契丹以一萬騎截擊，李嗣源只率百餘騎前突，脫下甲胄、躍馬揚鞭，用契丹語斥責對方，奮擊斬其酋長一人，晉軍後隊隨之殺入，奪佔山口。李存審隨即在退路上伐木為鹿角，擋住契丹回援之路；又令弱軍持燃燒柴草前進造煙遮天，晉軍擂鼓喧噪全軍出戰，李存審使後軍追擊，契丹大敗，自北山逃竄。整場戰鬥的節奏由阻滯、迂迴、卡口、煙幕突擊四段構成，晉軍以騎兵牽制、山道設伏與心理戰配合取勝。
tacticsEn: The Khitan method had two steps. In March they sent Lu Wenjin with a fast column against Xinzhou, taking the fortress first to serve as an outpost; the main army followed under Abaoji, defeated Zhou Dewei who had failed to take Xinzhou, and then closed around Youzhou. The defence, led by Lu Wenjin, combined attrition with engineering: they piled an earthen ramp beside the wall to look down into the city, dug tunnels to emerge in surprise attacks, and melted copper in the city and poured it down on the besiegers without ceasing day or night, so that the besiegers bled continuously through nearly two hundred days. The Jin response was a complicated strategic adjustment. Li Cunxu was locked with the Later Liang across the Yellow River and could not detach his whole army, so he first sent Li Siyuan out ahead to camp at the Laishui, with Yan Bao following with the Zhenzhou and Dingzhou troops, and the two columns met at Yizhou in August with about seventy thousand men in all. On the seventeenth of the eighth month Li Siyuan, Yan Bao and Li Cunshen set out north from Yizhou, crossed the Dafangling on the twenty-third and marched east along the mountain streams, drawing seventy thousand men into a long column along the valleys. On the afternoon of the twenty-third the vanguard of Li Siyuan and Li Congke, three thousand riders, met Khitan cavalry sixty li from Youzhou; the Khitan withdrew, the Jin followed in two wings, the Khitan holding the heights while the Jin moved in the gullies, and each narrowing of the valley was contested. At the mountain mouth the Khitan threw in a cavalry force of ten thousand to bar the way. Li Siyuan advanced with only a little more than a hundred riders, took off his armour, urged his horse forward with the whip, upbraided the enemy in the Khitan tongue, and cut down a chieftain in the fight, after which the Jin rear closed up and took the pass. Li Cunshen then felled timber on the line of retreat to make antler barricades and block the way Khitan relief might come, and ordered a weak detachment forward with burning brush to raise a smoke screen that hid the sky, while the Jin beat the drums, made a great clamour and brought the whole army out at once, with Li Cunshen sending the rear guard in pursuit. The Khitan broke and fled by the northern hill. The whole battle ran on four movements, obstruction, turning movement, holding the defile, and a smoke-screened assault, and the Jin won by combining cavalry containment, ambush in the mountain road and a psychological feint.
data: 可核的數字都出自《資治通鑑》與《舊五代史》的同一段記載：契丹阿保機自領大軍三十萬南下救援新州，圍城之際又聲稱有百萬之眾；晉軍周德威會合河東、鎮州、定州諸軍攻新州，十餘日不能下；幽州自三月被圍至八月解圍，前後近二百天；盧文進在城上以熔銅投擲，契丹士卒每日被殺近千人；七月時李嗣源、閻寶、李存審率軍七萬在易州會師；李嗣源父子率騎三千為前鋒，與契丹接戰時距幽州六十里；契丹在山口一次投入騎兵一萬；李嗣源自率百餘騎衝鋒，陣中斬契丹酋長一人；李存審設鹿角拒馬，契丹騎兵往返受阻、死傷人馬塞路；煙幕全軍出戰之後，晉軍追擊俘斬契丹兵卒萬餘，契丹丟棄戰車、帳篷、鎧甲、羊馬無數；八月廿四日李嗣源等入幽州，與周德威相見握手流涕。路程方面，從易州會師到翻越大房嶺、再沿山澗東行到幽州城六十里外，晉軍實際只用了六天。距離與數字互相對得上：一場近二百天的圍城，終結在一天之內的兩次遭遇戰中。
dataEn: The verifiable figures all come from the same passage of the Zizhi Tongjian and the Old History of the Five Dynasties. Abaoji led an army of three hundred thousand south to relieve Xinzhou himself, and while encircling Youzhou the Khitan claimed a host of a million; Zhou Dewei joined the troops of Hedong, Zhenzhou and Dingzhou to attack Xinzhou and failed to take it in more than ten days; Youzhou was under siege from March until the relief in August, close to two hundred days in all; with molten copper poured down from the walls, the Khitan lost nearly a thousand men a day; in the seventh month the armies of Li Siyuan, Yan Bao and Li Cunshen, seventy thousand strong, met at Yizhou; Li Siyuan and his son led three thousand riders as vanguard and came into contact with the Khitan sixty li from Youzhou; the Khitan committed a cavalry force of ten thousand at the mountain mouth; Li Siyuan charged forward with a little more than a hundred riders and cut down a Khitan chieftain in the fight; Li Cunshen's antler barricades blocked the Khitan and their casualties and horses jammed the road; after the smoke-screened general assault the Jin pursuit took or killed more than ten thousand Khitan soldiers, and the Khitan left behind carts, tents, armour, sheep and horses in great quantities; on the twenty-fourth of the eighth month Li Siyuan and the others entered Youzhou and met Zhou Dewei, who took his hand and wept. On distances, from the meeting at Yizhou to the crossing of the Dafangling and then east along the gullies to a point sixty li from Youzhou, the Jin used only six days, which matches the other figures: a siege lasting close to two hundred days was settled by two encounters within a single day.
cause: 起釀有四層。第一層是契丹建國後的擴張壓力：阿保機九一六年建國，草原帝國急於取得農耕地的賦稅與糧食，而燕雲十六州正是漢地農耕區與草原牧地交界的咽喉，自十六州割讓前就一直是中原王朝北方屏障所在，契丹要南下，幽州是必取的第一座關城。第二層是邊境既有的摩擦與漢地降將的介入：盧文進等盧龍軍舊將在削藩與內鬥中被排擠，轉投契丹，帶來城防佈置、糧道與守軍虛實的情報，使契丹得以先取新州作為跳板。第三層是李存勖自身的戰略困境：後梁未滅，他必須把主力放在黃河一線與梁軍對峙，幽州只能靠分兵往援，救援遲到就等於把幽州拱手讓人。第四層是季節與補給：草原部落在秋高馬肥之後或來年春草初生時出兵，本役三月發動、圍到八月，正逢燕地春耕夏耘、糧草最緊的季節，契丹三十萬大軍深入之後須就地徵糧，供應線拉得越長，軍心越難維持。兩個政權都明白同一件事：守住幽州，就等於守住燕雲的門戶；失掉幽州，北方屏障便向前洞開。
causeEn: There were four layers to the outbreak. The first was the pressure of expansion after the founding of the Khitan state: once Abaoji had proclaimed his empire in 916, the steppe state needed the taxes and grain of the farming lands, and the sixteen prefectures of Yan-Yun sat exactly where the agricultural districts met the steppe pastures, so they had always been the throat of the northern defence of the Central Plain, and the first fortress the Khitan had to take on the way south was Youzhou. The second was friction on the frontier already present and the involvement of Han defectors: old Lulong officers such as Lu Wenjin had been pushed aside in the Later Tang's reduction of the circuits and in its internal struggles, and their defection brought with it knowledge of the disposition of the defences, of the grain roads and of the true strength of the garrisons, which let the Khitan take Xinzhou first as a springboard. The third was Li Cunxu's own strategic predicament: the Later Liang was not yet destroyed, so his main body had to stay opposite the Liang army on the Yellow River, and Youzhou could only be relieved by detaching troops; if the relief came late, the city was lost by default. The fourth was season and supply: steppe peoples normally moved out after the autumn harvest when horse and grass were fat, or in spring when the new grass first grew, and this campaign opened in March and dragged on to August, exactly the season in which the Yan region was ploughing and sowing and grain was at its tightest, so a Khitan army of three hundred thousand penetrating so far had to live off the country, and the longer its supply line grew the harder it was to hold the army together. Both governments understood the same thing: to hold Youzhou was to hold the gateway of Yan-Yun, and to lose it was to open the northern shield of the Central Plain wide.
impact: 對當時而言，幽州之戰是一次邊界攻防而不是決戰：契丹沒有打下幽州，卻也沒有被打殘，兩國元氣都未傷，阿保機的南下第一次被中原騎兵正面擋回，幽州仍然是漢地藩鎮的邊城，仍在李存勖一系控制之下，北方防線維持原狀。對晉方內部，這場勝利鞏固了李存勖的威望與北方軍心的統一，李嗣源、李存審、閻寶、周德威四將在危局中的表現，讓晉王帳下得以繼續對付後梁；次年契丹再度南侵、李存勖親征，契丹北撤，兩國互市與兄弟之國的名分維持了相當長時間。對後世影響最深的，還是它把燕雲問題推到了檯面上：幽州這樣一座要塞反覆爭奪，說明中原王朝在北方既無可倚賴的天然屏障，也無力同時應付南面的內戰與北面的草原帝國；二十年後（九三六年）石敬瑭借契丹之力滅後晉、割讓燕雲十六州，幽州與雲州遂入契丹，九三七年遼太宗入主燕雲，中原從此失去北方屏障，直到宋金、蒙元之際北疆壓力再也無法化解。另一層影響在戰術層面：此役留下的據堅城、用地道與土山消耗敵軍、以少量騎兵卡住山口、以煙幕與鼓噪掩護全軍突擊的組合，被五代宋初的北方攻防反覆沿用。
impactEn: For the time itself, the battle of Youzhou was a border action rather than a decisive engagement. The Khitan did not take Youzhou, but neither were they broken, and neither side was exhausted, so the first southern thrust of the Khitan was turned back by Central Plain cavalry in open battle, while Youzhou remained the frontier city of a Han circuit, still held by Li Cunxu's line, and the northern defence line stood where it had stood. Inside the Jin, the victory confirmed Li Cunxu's prestige and the unity of the northern army's morale, and the showing of four commanders, Li Siyuan, Li Cunshen, Yan Bao and Zhou Dewei, in a crisis allowed the Prince of Jin to go on facing the Later Liang; the next year the Khitan invaded again and Li Cunxu campaigned in person, the Khitan withdrew north, and for a long time the two states kept up the fiction of brotherhood and their mutual markets. The deepest effect lay in what the war did to the Yan-Yun question: the repeated struggle for a fortress like Youzhou showed that the Central Plain dynasties had neither a natural barrier to rely on in the north nor the strength to fight a war in the south and against a steppe empire in the north at the same time. Twenty years later, in 936, Shi Jingtang used Khitan strength to destroy the Later Jin and ceded the sixteen prefectures of Yan-Yun, so that Youzhou and Yunzhou passed to the Khitan; in 937 Liao Taizong entered Yan-Yun as its ruler, and from that day the Central Plain lost its northern shield, a loss it was never able to repair before the Song-Jin and Mongol-Yuan wars brought pressure from the north beyond remedy. At the tactical level the campaign left behind a combination that was used again and again in the northern offences and defences of the Five Dynasties and early Song: hold the fortress, use tunnels and earthen ramps to grind down the besiegers, bar the mountain mouth with a handful of cavalry, and cover a general assault with smoke and noise.
result: 結局是契丹敗、晉軍勝，但勝得很勉強。三月起圍，圍了將近二百天，幽州城未被攻破，守軍靠地道、土山與熔銅付出極大代價才熬到八月；八月十七日至廿三日，晉軍在易州山道連續突擊，廿三日於山口與北山之間打崩契丹主力，斬獲與俘獲合計萬餘，契丹丟下戰車、帳篷、鎧甲與羊馬，向北山遁走，圍城之師解體。八月廿四日，李嗣源、李存審、閻寶入幽州，與苦守近二百日的周德威相見握手流涕，幽州之圍至此解除。契丹的南進沒有達成，據史籍所載，其後契丹主與晉王之間維持以兄弟之國相稱的關係，互有往來，只是燕雲一線的爭奪並未因此結束。從全局看，此役是五代初中原王朝在北方邊防上少數站穩的一次，但也正因如此，幽州的重要性被抬高到無法再忽視的地步——它太重要，重要到二十多年後必須用割地的方式才能暫時解決。戰術層面則留下了教科書式的樣本：以易州為集結點、山道行軍卡住谷口、鹿角拒馬封退路、煙幕配合全軍出戰，晉軍以七萬兵力破掉契丹三十萬大軍的攻勢，是冷兵器時代以機動與火術逆轉的典型戰例。
resultEn: The outcome was a Khitan defeat and a Jin victory, but a narrow one. The siege opened in March and lasted close to two hundred days; Youzhou was never taken, and the garrison only held on to August at the price of tunnels, an earthen ramp and melted copper. Between the seventeenth and the twenty-third of the eighth month the Jin struck again and again along the Yizhou mountain road, and on the twenty-third they broke the Khitan main body between the mountain mouth and the northern hill, taking and killing more than ten thousand, while the Khitan abandoned carts, tents, armour, sheep and horses and ran off by the northern hill, so the siege army dissolved. On the twenty-fourth of the eighth month Li Siyuan, Li Cunshen and Yan Bao entered Youzhou and met Zhou Dewei, who had held out for close to two hundred days; they took his hand and wept, and the siege of Youzhou was over. The Khitan southern advance had achieved nothing, and according to the historical records the Khitan ruler and the Prince of Jin afterwards maintained relations as brother states with exchanges in both directions, though the contest for Yan-Yun was by no means closed. Taken as a whole, this was one of the few occasions on which a Central Plain dynasty held firm on its northern frontier in the early Five Dynasties, but for that very reason the importance of Youzhou was raised to a level that could no longer be ignored: it was so important that a little more than two decades later the problem had to be settled, however temporarily, by the cession of land. At the tactical level the battle left a model case: concentrating at Yizhou, moving along the mountain road to bar the defile, closing the line of retreat with antler barricades, and using a smoke screen to cover a general assault, the Jin used seventy thousand men to break the offensive of an army of three hundred thousand, a classic reversal of cold-weapon warfare won by manoeuvre and fire.
